# A semicircle at rounding noise: no flip

One of the slotted plate's semicircles, sweep π, its end moved by one unit
in the last place of x. `cross(s − c, e − c)` changes sign (from `+5e-14`
to `−5e-14`), so a sign of the cross product would call it a flip; the
tracked sweep moves by about `2e-15` around π, nowhere near 0 or 2π: no
flip (ADR-0006).
